title: The census and refresh read the lookups' cached revalidations as hints and skip re-fetching what a lookup checked within the provider's pacing
goal: factdiff.py detect, census.py check and kb-refresh read the revalidation results lookups left in _cache/ (fact key, source id, outcome, date) and skip the request for a source a lookup revalidated within its provider's pacing window, while dating only what their own run confirms (D-tvjml75q); the census summary counts the sources a hint spared; the suite tests a planted cached result.
